slides.title: Three wheels or four, 90mm or 125mm?
slides.sub: How to pick the right Aerolite speed frame

slides.title: Start with two questions
slides.body: How big do you want your wheels, and do you want three or four? Wheel size sets top speed and ride height. Wheel count sets agility against stability.

slides.title: Six frames side by side
slides.caption: Wheel count, wheel size, length and weight for each frame.

slides.title: Low and controlled: 4x90
slides.body: Four 90mm wheels keep you low with four points of contact. Grip and predictable handling for banked track and short courses. The 90x3 is its lighter, nimbler cousin.

slides.title: One frame for everything: 4x100
slides.body: More rollout than 90mm, more stability than three wheels. The balanced choice if you train, tour and race on the same skates.

slides.title: Road and marathon speed
slides.body: The 4x110 is long, planted and tracks straight at race pace. The 3x125 is lighter and livelier. The Hi Lo pitches you forward for long distance.

slides.title: Check your mounting first
slides.body: The range uses 150mm, 165mm and 195mm patterns depending on the frame. The 4x110 is 195mm only, so confirm your boot before you order.
